name: 테라-글로스 (Terra-Gloss)
quote: 기어와 화염이 닿는 곳에 진정한 금빛이 깃든다.
silhouette: 둥근 뿔, 굵고 짧은 기계 꼬리, 거대한 스패너, 빛나는 황금색 몸체
signature_vfx: 스패너 끝에서 터져 나오는 화려한 황금빛 불꽃 파편
visual_en: A small 3-head ratio dragon-humanoid with bright golden glowing eyes and short copper hair. A thick tail embedded with metallic gears swings behind. The character wears heavy golden steam-plated armor and a leather harness. A massive, glowing golden spanner is held in one hand, emitting sparks. A small tool bag hangs on the waist, alongside a burning golden fuel canister that radiates a strong golden aura. The entire silhouette is accented with bright gold and orange flame particles.
pose_en: Striking a bold pose while swinging a heavy wrench with fiery sparks flying.
vfx_en: Exploding golden sparks and bright orange flame particles.
